summary: Both editions were reviewed independently against every clause of the selected Greek working source. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Both preserve the plural holy spirits, clothing and name imagery, necessary conditions and negations, unity assertions, exchange of powers, expulsion, and handing over to the women. The simplified wording retains these claims without adding doctrinal conditions. Reader-facing “servants” follows current policy. The notes distinguish editorial supplements from preserved wording and accurately qualify the supplied apparatus and comparison reports, including unresolved alternative syntax. Acceptance concerns these supplied drafts and their disclosure; it does not authenticate unseen manuscripts or certify exhaustive collation.
